files.notes: Keyframes sampled by elapsed time with smoothstep, unwrapped yaw, named phases, a version string that pins the anchors. Ours: times are run fractions so the 60 s short run flies the same tour, phases are strategic/pan/zoom/ground/combined/return, anchors scouted on our village, and placement goes through CameraController.place. Slice 28: clamp from `math`, smoothstep from renderer-core math.

A versioned scenario with a seed, a start tick reached by stepping the real simulation, a duration and the camera script version. Ours: the village with blue on the scout-suppress-flank script in the WASM battle, a short run, and a fingerprint test that fails a workload change without a version bump.

The first timed frame opens the window, capacity bounded by duration, intended and achieved camera per frame. Ours adds per-tick step time and publication bytes, and reads GPU time and memory from BattleFrame.stats() every 2 s instead of matching per-submission GPU events.
Nearest-rank percentiles and null (not zero) for no samples. Ours: one summarize() for frame, CPU, GPU, step and byte series, plus average FPS and frames over 33 ms per phase.

A JSON report with identity, outcome, summary, per-phase summaries, raw frames and the simulated seconds. Ours adds the tour, tick and memory sections, and derives the frame-cost.md row from the report.

Preparing, running, then finished (complete, cancelled or failed), with timing starting only once the authority stands at the start tick. Ours drives it from the viewport pilot and the worker's advance request; no held-authority mode.
Headline metrics, frame chart, per-phase table, identity, and run again / export JSON / back to menu. Ours: our own layout and sections (simulation, memory, machine).
Equal-time bins drawn as min–max ranges over phase bands. Ours: an SVG with mean frame and mean GPU lines and 120/60/30 FPS guides, no hover.

tier joint remap by name and merged meshes; tiers come from _LOD<n> names in one GLB, and clips bake once per skeleton
bounds as the union of every tier over every baked clip frame; the Float32 rounding proof is not ported
atomic install of complete bundles; ours fetches binary bundles by content hash and verifies each
the appearance-bundle contract (atomic, explicit tiers finest first, explicit loop flags, one skin); encoding is ours
generator idea kept (GLBs built in code, never checked in); rewritten as a builder for a soldier, tank, truck and building
import round-trip and malformed-input cases, against our API
posed geometry after the basis equals the rotated source pose
bounds hold densely sampled poses between baked frames
deterministic bake and tier/joint layout, against our binary bundles

rewritten from reading as TerrainSurface: the ground is the simulation's exported triangles (flat-shaded, no bilinear grid, no 1.6x relief), with the plot split, roads, forests and water from the simulation's export; drawn by the world pass, not its own pipeline set

rewritten from reading: the mottle/drift value noise and feathered road edge ideas, over a per-pixel walk of the plot split and the simulation's road segments and rects instead of a baked distance texture; no rock, scree, far-grass or water layers; palettes from fixtures/biomes/summer.json

one vertex path for every bundle kind (articulated and static as rigid palettes), per-appearance per-tier buffers, records packed per draw, a caster variant for the cascades; no crowd audiences, surfaces or texture images
one invocation per instance walking the hierarchy into world times inverseBind; raw WGSL over our dense clip table instead of TypeGPU-wrapped source helpers
palette, control and sample storage owned by the frame's registry; no snapshot banks or upper-body layer; one crossfade clip
the shortest-arc slerp and TRS-to-matrix helpers, with WGSL's sin in place of the Taylor sine

rewritten from reading as a Blender script: the lobed crown (a core sphere unioned with seeded lobe spheres, sampled radially) with Voronoi leaf clumps, ellipsoid-leaning normals and baked occlusion in vertex colour; four tiers sampled from one shape; no leaf cards or leaf atlas; exported as scene-assets appearances

rewritten from reading: detail chosen per tree by projected pixel height, with four tiers (biome lod_px) instead of leaves/canopy, over chunks so far chunks draw whole at tier 3 from a static buffer; no hysteresis or leaf fade

rewritten from reading: forests filled by area; here the simulation's forest rects, canopy heights and trunks are the authority (crowns inside each rect and under its canopy over the simulation's ground), and hedgerows and copses stand only past the map on the patchwork's plot edges

tiers made inside the export scene as _LOD<n> copies of one joined skinned mesh, not saved files; islands and the joined result put in a canonical order so the export hashes the same every run; no tangent-frame repair (bundles carry no normal maps)

rewritten from reading: compute routing into near/far tiers with atomic append and indexed indirect draws, terrain-normal-dominant shading; ours regrows clumps per view from world tiles on the GPU (no CPU records), places them by rank on a per-tile R2 sequence, samples the terrain material for colour and masks, receives sun shadows and takes FogTerm as ground
rewritten from reading: the travelling gust band plus per-blade phase and a height-squared bend; not its per-vertex Bezier blade, colour ramp or emissive rim
rewritten from reading: screen-footprint gating of grass by pixels per blade; ours is a continuous density law and a reach from the fade footprint, with no residency, focus tiles or quality ladder
rewritten from reading: a stable field whose records never reshuffle under small camera moves; ours derives each clump from its world tile and rank alone
